subject: Upgrading R to Version 3 in Shiny Server

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: Upgrading R to Version 3 in Shiny Server
parts: I wanted to test my application on the Shiny hosting account but it gives an error because it is unable to load package lubridate. The version of R on the server is 2.1X ,but there are packages out there that require at least 3.0. Is there a plan to update R to a later release?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Upgrading R to Version 3 in Shiny Server
parts: No, glimmer and spark are not likely to be updated to 3.0, and will be deprecated sooner or later. We are directing new signups to our new (beta) hosting service at http://shinyapps.io which uses a different architecture and has R 3.0.
On Mon, Dec 23, 2013 at 11:47 AM, David Ardestani <dard...@gmail.com> wrote:

I wanted to test my application on the Shiny hosting account but it gives an error because it is unable to load package lubridate. The version of R on the server is 2.1X ,but there are packages out there that require at least 3.0. Is there a plan to update R to a later release?
